# Hypothesis Candidate Drafting — DV: Automaticity

> **Disclaimer:** These are generative conjectures inferred from qualitative pattern variation
> across IV levels in a small sample. They are not causal estimates from a hypothesis test
> and should not be reported as such.

## Candidate 1

**Hypothesis:** Higher hypnotic suggestibility is associated with greater automaticity in
ideomotor responses.
